scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem concerns only the 128 conics already proved to lie in the three-distinct-entry locus; it does not prove that these exhaust all conics on the surface. The proof uses the standard Galois transitivity theorem for prime divisors and the source's exact component count. Originality remains subject to the stated risk of unindexed literature.
title: The 128 known rational conics form one automorphism orbit
